title: KATA Intent Mandate
description: Immutable signed intent bound to one agent key. The principal's signature covers the intent, the limits, the human-readable rendering, and the agent key. Status: framework note. The agreement record that carries this mandate is schemas/agreement.json. amounts stay major units, as in schemas/intent.json.

mandate_id.description: Identifier of this mandate version. A new version uses a new mandate_id.

version.description: Mandate version. Amendments increment it. intent.version is kept equal to it.

supersedes.description: Hash of the signing document of the mandate version this one replaces.

algorithm.description: Signature algorithm. EdDSA is Ed25519. ES256 is ECDSA P-256 with SHA-256. The JWS header alg is this value.

confirmation_language.description: Language of the canonical confirmation text KATA produces. en is built in. The wallet displays this text and does not replace it.

public_key_fingerprint.description: SHA-256 of the raw public key. Ed25519 uses the 32-byte key. P-256 uses the 64-byte x||y.

delegation_id.description: Delegation this mandate is stored inside.

parent_limits.description: Signed copy of the agreement parent set. This intent must not exceed it.

intent.description: Structured intent. maximum_amount is the per-transaction ceiling.

expires_at.description: When the mandate lapses. When intent.time_limit is also set, the two are the same instant.

required_acknowledgements.description: Roles that must countersign before the agreement is active.

revocation_endpoint.description: Where a verifier reads revocation status. The reference library does not fetch it. If this is set, evaluation steps up until the caller says the endpoint was checked.

text.description: Confirmation the principal signed, in any language. The hash is SHA-256 of these exact bytes. The default English rendering is used only when the signer does not supply text.

hash.description: SHA-256 of the UTF-8 rendering text.

publicJwk.description: Public JWK for Ed25519 (OKP) or P-256 (EC). The private parameter d is not a member of this object.

jws.description: Flattened JWS (RFC 7515), alg EdDSA or ES256. Protected header and payload are KATA canonical JSON.

parentLimits.description: The parent set for every live intent. Per-transaction ceilings are not added together. Cumulative slices are.

per_transaction_maximum.description: Restatement of intent.maximum_amount. The two must be equal. This is not a second ceiling.

cumulative_maximum.description: This intent's slice of the parent total. Distinct from the per-transaction ceiling. KATA records spend on the agreement ledger.

per.description: agreement is the whole window. P1D is one day, P7D is seven days, P1M is thirty days.

merchant_denylist.description: Merchants refused even when merchant_constraints is empty. Empty merchant_constraints still means no allowlist.
